title: Lisse essential surjectivity of a normalized contractible component corner
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, $T$ a w-contractible affine scheme, and $c$ a normalized component corner [lem-zl-component-derived-pullback-square]. For every dualizable $N\in D(T,\Lambda)$ there is a dualizable $M\in D(\pi_0T,\Lambda)$ and an isomorphism $c^*M\cong N$. All coefficient transports and ordinary unbounded derived categories are those of the normalized corner [def-zl-condensed-generic-scalar-model-data].

proof.text: w-contractible lisse evaluation gives the component equivalence on dualizable objects, with its canonical coefficient comparison. Compare the corner's inverse image with that functor using inverse_eq and the uniqueness of adjunction mates. The absolute-test projection normalization identifies the two beta comparisons: their right-adjoint mates are restriction along the same test-object isomorphism. The coefficient_eq field then identifies their coefficient transports. Lift this comparison to ordinary module functors and derive it termwise. Apply essential surjectivity of the lisse equivalence to N. The inverse object is dualizable, and the equivalence counit composed with the comparison gives the required isomorphism. For the empty affine or zero ring both categories have only zero objects.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 4.13, irreducible case, diagram (4.4) and paragraph following it; Lemma 4.1 and Proposition 4.3(3)
